title: MZ I have made a Summoning/Party plugin

posts.author: smileking
posts.body:
It isn't finished but being broke is a pretty good motivator for making my own plugins, since i can't pay royalties or any of that...
So yes I have made a plugin that sort of works, you can do summons, where in mid battle calling a plugin command thea skill or scripted moment, where you can add a temporary member to your party, and increase team size for battle while auto scrolling to the new temp character, and then removing them at the end of combat, but i also have a method to just increase or decrease the party size for the rest of game, and it works the same way, just for your actual party members!
What do I plan to add to this plugin???
I plan to add a special type of summon called Ritual summons that actually check throughout combat if their summoner is dead, and if so, the summon will then turn to a set enemy counter part and then join the enemy team. Add a temp member who can actually stay and auto go into combat until manually removed in a event, and I plan to add auto choice temp members, meaning that the summon would basically not be controlled by player choice and instead would work like a enemy but on the player's side. I also plan to add a way to reuse the same Actor in a temp teammate but just copy them in runtime rather than have to make more actors but copies...
How do Temp members work?
So a summon or as the plugin calls them, Temp members, Temps as we'll call them here work by choosing an actor and then basically pushing them into combat, seeting them in the turn order, updating UI, and then boom, Temp, that's really it, not really complicated...
Will this plugin cost money when finished???
NO!
Yes people who download it will have the option to donate to me but other than that, it will be free to use for personal/commercial projects, because I believe in coding to be free! And besides, other than function, my looks aren't that good...
